Name: NSFW Photos - Heart Album -  Genderswap Bachelors
Author: sweetinsanity9
Description:
[center]This mod adds photos to the photo album mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43247]Heart Album[/url]. Each heart/friendship level unlocks a new photo for each character which will be added to the album. [/center]
[center]
If you want the sprites and names of the bachelors to be genderswapped as well, you will want to get the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url].[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img width=256,height=256]https://www.image2url.com/r2/default/images/1783860637319-75c2b7cd-8be3-429f-9c4b-5b67ed63e0c2.png[/img][/center]
[center]Download the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43247][color=#00ffff]Heart Album[/color][/url] from here on Nexus.[/center]
[center]Unzip my mod's folder and navigate to the folder [color=#00ff00][i]Mods\NycdeAlbumMod2\Assets[/i][/color][/center]
[center]Copy and paste the pngs from my mod's folder into this folder and you're done![/center]
[center]Press[color=#ff00ff] F8 [/color]once in game to open the album and view your photos.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img width=273,height=273]https://www.image2url.com/r2/default/images/1784166027784-90372fde-eb11-488d-87cc-8bb0b288bd42.png[/img][/center]
[center]There is an [color=#ffff00][u]optional[/u][/color] download in this mod's download page to add photos for Krobus.
Use the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8266][color=#00ffff]Krobus Relationship Changes[/color][/url] to be able to add the necessary heart leveling system for this mod to work. 
Copy and paste the Krobus pngs from my mod's folder into the same folder as the main mod:[i][color=#00ff00] Mods\NycdeAlbumMod2\Assets[/color][/i][/center]
[center]Same as before- open the album with [color=#ff00ff]F8 [/color]to view your photos
[img width=200,height=300]https://www.image2url.com/r2/default/images/1785114468663-4c8c6470-7c0f-4d56-bc16-d2fb2b8e012f.png[/img][/center]
[center]Want to see extra content of mine that I can't post here?
[b][url=https://discord.gg/USrf9wrK4][color=#ff00ff]Join my discord![/color][/url] [/b]
I will be posting any mod files I cannot post here over on my discord channel~

Hope you all enjoy~
[/center]
